description: This file defines an abstract base class 'UiTestBase' for UI tests using NUnit and Selenium WebDriver. It manages setup and teardown of WebDriver instances, supports a discovery-only mode where no real browser is launched, and provides a guard method to ensure tests do not perform WebDriver actions during discovery mode.

classes.name: UiTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for UI tests providing setup, teardown, and a discovery mode safeguard.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes settings and WebDriver before each test execution.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up WebDriver resources after each test.

methods.name: GuardDiscoveryOnly
methods.description: Prevents WebDriver actions if running in discovery-only mode, ensuring tests do not launch real browsers in CI.
